aifact: Unlike human developers who possess contextual knowledge, AI agents depend entirely on explicit, machine-readable API contracts and schemas to execute tasks.
aifactinsight: Ambiguous API structures cause agents to 'hallucinate shapes,' causing production execution blockages. Resolve this in Q2 2026 by enforcing strict request/response validation against OpenAPI specs at the gateway edge to reject non-compliant payloads instantly.

aifact: Enforcing deterministic agent behavior requires explicit state lifecycle modeling, uniform pagination patterns, and mandatory idempotency keys for state-changing operations.
aifactinsight: Agent errors amplify quickly, turning non-idempotent conflicts into accidental denial-of-wallet loop attacks. Protect infrastructure by enforcing `Idempotency-Key` headers on side-effects and returning structured RFC 7807 problem details payloads.

aifact: In agentic architectures, OpenAPI specifications and integration protocols like MCP serve as live, runtime executable contracts rather than passive documentation.
aifactinsight: Wrapping inconsistent legacy APIs in tool discovery layers only accelerates system failures. Optimize specifications for LLM function-calling by stripping vague properties, utilizing explicit `enum` arrays, and providing detailed parameters.
